title: Sheafification preserves affine values of localizing module presheaves
statement: Let T be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and P a presheaf of O_T-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Assume that, for every affine open U of T and a ∈ Γ(T,U), the restriction P(U) → P(D(a)), considered as a Γ(T,U)-linear map by restricting scalars on its target, is a module localization at the powers of a. Then for every affine open W of T, the canonical module sheafification unit [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification] P(W) → P^#(W) is an isomorphism of Γ(T,W)-modules.

source.place: Section 6.30, especially Lemmas 6.30.6, 6.30.9 and 6.30.12; Tag 01HV for the localization sheaf on a spectrum.

proof.text: On a fixed affine W = Spec A, put N=P(W). Localization uniqueness identifies P(D(a)) with the sections of tilde N on D(a), via the numerator maps. Compatibility with further principal restrictions follows from the uniqueness of maps out of localizations and presheaf composition. The localized structure-ring action is determined by the A-action and invertibility of a, so these are module identifications.

The principal opens form an intersection-closed basis on W. Their localization modules satisfy unique gluing because tilde N is a sheaf; arbitrary covers reduce to finite principal covers by quasi-compactness. Extend from the basis. Sheafification has the same stalks as the presheaf, so on W it is the unique basis extension, and the unit on each principal open is the preceding identification. At W = D(1), the unit is thus an isomorphism. Empty covers work because localization at zero forces P(empty)=0.

mathlib_searches.results: Generic tilde and localization constructions; no theorem for raw cohomology or affine values of a general presheaf sheafification. Existing invertS_cohomology and higherDirectImagePresheaf interfaces read separately.

mathlib_searches.query: IsLocalizedModule; sheafification unit; basis in Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Modules, Mathlib/Algebra/Category/ModuleCat/Presheaf and Mathlib/Topology/Sheaves
mathlib_searches.results: Tilde.toOpen localization; IsLocalizedModule.Away.surj; isIso_toSheafify for already sheaf presheaves; basis extension tools. No matching raw cohomology localization or affine-unit assertion for a presheaf satisfying localizations. Repository and DAG searched for duplicates.

mathlib_searches.query: IsLocalizedModule.Away; sheafification agrees with a presheaf on a gluing basis; module_sheafification_iso_of_affine_restriction
mathlib_searches.results: Loogle finds Away and local algebra criteria; LeanFinder finds sheaf hom ext, cover-dense amalgamation and sheafification constructions. Read Mathlib tilde.toOpen localization, existing invertS_cohomology, higherDirectImagePresheaf, basis extension, and module_sheafification_iso_of_affine_restriction. The latter assumes a supplied affine-basis identification with a sheaf and does not establish the localization-to-canonical-unit bridge. No direct duplicate found.

theorem affineLocalization_sheafification_unit_isIso (T : Scheme.{u})
    (P : _root_.PresheafOfModules.{u} T.ringCatSheaf.obj)
    (hlocal : ∀ (U : T.Opens), IsAffineOpen U → ∀ a : Γ(T, U),
      let : Module Γ(T, U) (P.obj (op (T.basicOpen a))) :=
        Module.compHom _ (T.presheaf.map (homOfLE (T.basicOpen_le a)).op).hom
      IsLocalizedModule.Away a (P.map (homOfLE (T.basicOpen_le a)).op).hom)
    (W : T.Opens) (hW : IsAffineOpen W) :
    IsIso (((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction
      (𝟙 T.ringCatSheaf.obj)).unit.app P).app (op W))
